overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: informal monthly gatherings of town board chairs lacked a quorum of any board and the chairs' group was not a public body.

allegations.summary: Monthly dinners of town board chairs (health, selectmen, school committee) were alleged to be unnoticed, non-compliant meetings of a public body.
allegations.key_passage: Such an informal gathering of public officials does not constitute a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Whether the chairs' gatherings amounted to a quorum of the Board of Health or Board of Selectmen meeting under the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Here, there was no quorum of any public body present at the meetings of the board chairs.

source.publisher_filename: DETERMINATION - 6 25 2012 - OML 2012-51 - WINCHENDON BOARD OF HEALTH.pdf
